items.title: PM admits One Nation's rise influenced decision to overhaul tax system
items.description: The rise of One Nation is partly behind the government's decision to take on tax reform in this year's budget, the prime minister has admitted.

items.title: Sydney police officer sentenced over death of Indigenous 16yo
items.description: A NSW Police officer convicted over a fatal collision that killed an Indigenous teenager has avoided time behind bars.

items.title: Sunscreens that failed to meet SPF claims still under investigation
items.description: Most of the sunscreens that failed to meet their SPF label claims, according to independent testing, are still under investigation by the regulator one year later.

items.title: Recorded flu numbers drop drastically but expert warns caution
items.description: Flu cases have come down since the record-breaking 2025 season but experts warn against a "false sense of security".

items.title: Daughter says parents' rural home stabbing 'deeply traumatising'
items.description: The daughter of a couple who suffered critical stab wounds during a suspected home invasion on a remote property said the family is traumatised by the incident.

items.title: Live: ASIC tells parliament it has eight current contracts with KPMG, despite audit scandal
items.description: ASIC has told Senate estimates it has eight active contracts with KPMG, despite the company facing an audit scandal. Follow the day's events and insights as they happen with our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Bikie scales dock, escapes Darwin courthouse triggering police manhunt
items.description: A manhunt is under way in Darwin as police search for Brandt Graham, a 44-year-old Mongols bikie who scaled an enclosed courthouse dock and escaped from custody today.

items.title: Emissions drop again, fuelling hopes Australia's hit a tipping point
items.description: Emissions are at their lowest point since the COVID pandemic shut down the economy, dropping 2.1 per cent over the year to December 2025.

items.title: This is where Israel's military crossed Lebanon's Litani River
items.description: Images of the first tanks to roll over Lebanon's Litani River were posted online this week. ABC NEWS Verify has found the spot where Israel's military crossed.

items.title: Prolific character actor stabbed to death in front yard at age 81
items.description: James Handy appeared in almost 150 films or TV series, according to his IMDb page, with his last role being a bartender in Top Gun: Maverick.

items.title: Kumanjayi Little Baby's family were forced to leave home community, MP says
items.description: Member for Lingiari Marion Scrymgour says the mother of Kumanjayi Little Baby had been living in insecure housing in Alice Springs so she could access specialist support for her daughter, before the five-year-old's tragic death in April.

items.title: Mary Fowler has crossed the threshold from athlete to cultural icon
items.description: Matildas star Mary Fowler is using her platform to share what matters to her, as she navigates becoming a truly global footballing superstar.

items.title: Dorothy the kitten who survived the unthinkable reunited with its rescuer
items.description: A kitten left for dead after being thrown from a moving car has spent months recovering and is now at a new home with two familiar faces.

items.title: Women say getting a long-acting reversible contraceptive has been the 'best decision'
items.description: Misinformation, cost and a lack of trained providers have stopped many Australian women from accessing what doctors consider the most effective form of reversible contraception.

items.title: Princess Catherine hugs young mum ringing 'end of cancer treatment' bell
items.description: The Princess of Wales joined in a hospital cancer ward celebration for a young mum who completed chemotherapy.

items.title: Need a mood boost? Here's why gardening might be worth a try
items.description: While gardening alone is not a treatment for mental illness, a growing body of evidence links it with higher levels of mental wellbeing and life satisfaction.

items.title: Looking for another show like Off Campus? Right this way
items.description: Hannah and Garrett's steamy love story might be on ice, but we've found more romance and yearning to tick your comfort-viewing boxes.

items.title: ABC news quiz: Mystery markings, a premature celebration and a fight over the Big… something
items.description: You too could learn the dangers of celebrating too soon if you underestimate this week's news quiz.

items.title: Visitors are up, but Mona remains reliant on gambling funds
items.description: Newly filed accounts give a first glimpse of Mona's ultimate holding company, showing the loss-making gallery remains heavily reliant on gambling funds.

items.title: Doctor in tears over 'atypical' moles as social media craze causes concern
items.description: Skin specialists are sounding a warning about the potential cancer risks associated with unregulated peptides at the heart of a social media-driven beauty craze.

items.title: Court system 'in a shambles' after transcription service goes bust
items.description: There are fears mass redundancies at Australia's main transcription service could leave court cases around the country in limbo after it was revealed VIQ Solutions would be wound down.

items.title: 'ISIS bride' charged with slavery poses risk if granted bail, court hears
items.description: Zeinab Ahmad, who recently returned to Australia, is seeking bail after she was charged with slavery offences after allegedly crossing into Syria with her family in 2015.

items.title: Rumours, rifts and a reported resignation form a murky picture of a war-ravaged Iran
items.description: A report about the resignation of Iran's president earlier this week came at a turbulent moment for Iran's regime, which is grappling with frictions between moderates and hardliners as the war drags on.

items.title: Iranian-French cartoonist Marjane Satrapi, author of Persepolis, dead at 56
items.description: A committed advocate to furthering free speech and women's rights in her birth country, Satrapi lost her husband, Swedish actor Mattias Ripa, in April last year, and "died of sadness", according to French media.

items.title: Sex discrimination commissioner slams gender definition proposal
items.description: Australia's sex discrimination commissioner condemns a proposal to reinstate biological definition of sexes as a "step back" for women.
